english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DB03

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £50 to £60 as from 1/07/13.
(ii) The Boards are the British Railways Board, the British Transport Docks Board, the British Waterways Board, the Freight Corporation and any wholly-owned subsidiary of Freight Corporation and London Regional Transport. By virtue of the Railway Act 1993 (Consequential Modification)(No 2) Order 1999, references to the Boards in the 1949 Act, or to their wholly-owned subsidiaries, shall include references to any successor to the British Railways Board.
(iii) No person shall be subject to a penalty under this offence unless it is proved to the satisfaction of the court that a public warning had been given to persons not to trespass upon the railway by a clearly exhibited notice.
(iv) This Act does not apply to station concourses or platforms.
